Name: Kantrip's DCBurger style Older Sam Portrait Set
Author: Kantrip
Description:
[size=3]The perfect "Older" Sam portrait didn't exist, so I made one for myself. I tried to style-copy DCBurger and OrangePie, and hopefully succeeded somewhat. I would also like to credit ktruong's "Sam - New Hair and Jacket" portrait set for inspiration.

This mod is a promissory note to myself. I know how my brain works when making mods, and I have to start with the visuals. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9938]OrangePie's DCBurger style Short Hair Sebastian[/url] portrait heavily inspired me to create my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31574]Older Sebastian[/url] dialogue and events mod -- I played with it constantly and love it to pieces. So I knew that I needed something similar for Sam.

This mod includes four Sam variants -- Beard/NoBeard and a long/short hair version of each. 
[/size]

[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url]﻿, for seasonal outfits (this mod includes a winter portrait)[/size]
[*][size=3]Create a new folder inside Mods/Portraiture. Call it whatever you want; I call mine "Kantrip"[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip this mod and choose a portrait set from the ones listed above. Paste all four .png files into your new Portraiture folder[/size]
